items.title: 68429_Walter P. Thomas oral history interview
items.q: So when Chu came in, I knew Chu could play better than me, so Chu started playing the solos.

ctx.x: [INAUDIBLE NAME] talks about studying with Merle Johnson.

Yeah. Because he studied with Merle at the same time I did. And all the guys liked me, because see, I was one of the first Black guys to go up there and study. So I was like a... And I was playing with Cab, too.

And I remember one thing that Merle told me. See, I was the first guy to play the solos. So when Chu came in, I knew Chu could play better than me, so Chu started playing the solos. And you know when Ben Webster comes in, I had to take...
